description: fakevpc/v1 — Simulation leaf that PRODUCES an id: on reconcile it derives a deterministic fake vpc_id from spec.account_id and writes it to status. The upstream half of a dependency + value-flow demo (consumer = fakeapp); a composer emits a ValueFlow from this status.vpc_id into a downstream's spec.

account_id.description: Account this fake VPC lives in; the produced vpc_id is derived from it.

vpc_id.description: The produced VPC id downstream resources consume via a ValueFlow.
